title: CULTURE IN ACTION: EVALUATING TEXT-TO-IMAGE MODELS THROUGH SOCIAL ACTIVITIES
findings: Models showed mixed results for generating images of religious activities. This category appeared among both the best-3 and worst-3 performing subactivities, which highlights systematic but varied strengths and weaknesses of current models when dealing with highly culturally-grounded topics like religion.
